text:
rachel: quick heads-up — kicking off onboarding for seadragon-embed v0 (int4) on staging, small holdout sweep first

Tom: nice. which quant path? per-channel or global?

rachel: per-channel asymmetric + clamp-tune (we tried symmetric earlier, gave weird offsets)

ade: what metrics are we watching? recall@5/10? MAP? clustering?

rachel: primary: recall@1/5, MAP@10, NMI and silhouette for clustering, plus cosine mean/std shift vs heron-baseline. also histogram of cosine deltas for top-5 classes

jon: include kmeans purity top-20 and median neighbor distance shift. those caught a few int4 edge regressions last round

eval-bot: queued: dataset=anchor-news-10k, model=seadragon-v0/int4, configs=[per-channel,clamp-tune], run_id=run_2026_03_21_377888

rachel: quick run done: posting summary (compact): recall@1=0.645 (-0.018 vs heron), recall@5=0.802 (-0.025), MAP@10=0.73 (-0.03), NMI=0.42 (-0.04), silhouette=0.49 (-0.06)

Tom: that's larger than I'd like, especially silhouette. any class-level hotspots?

rachel: yes — topic "legal" and "policy" clusters stretched; kmeans purity for those dropped ~0.12 absolute. other classes stable

ade: can you dump cosine delta histogram? curious if it's broad shift or fat tail

rachel: pasted snippet: cos_delta_mean=-0.012, cos_delta_std=0.035, tail(<=-0.08)=1.9%

jon: 2% heavy negative tail could explain recall@1 misses. did we enable bias-correction during quant? that helps tails sometimes

rachel: no bias-correction in this run. I'll flip on per-channel bias-correction + lr clamp tweak and rerun. ETA ~18m

Tom: also run a tiny 100k-query online-style sim to see long-tail failure modes (random short queries, 1-3 tokens)

rachel: adding short-query sim now

eval-bot: run-started id=run_2026_03_21_377888_B

rachel: rerun done. diff vs prior int4: recall@1 improved to -0.009 gap, recall@5 -0.012 gap, MAP@10 -0.013, silhouette now -0.018. cosine tail <=-0.08 down to 0.6%

ade: that's promising. what's perf hit vs int8 baseline?

rachel: latency p50: int8=11ms, int4=7.2ms (-34%). throughput +40% in our microbench.

jon: nice perf win. what about reproducibility across seeds? rerun twice?

rachel: ran 3x seeds on a smaller 3k holdout — recall@5 std=0.4%, silhouette std=0.009. stable enough for canary.

Tom: any change needed to embedding postproc? norm or recalibration?

rachel: small re-norm step (L2 normalize after quant dequant) made a 0.5% bump in recall@1 in a quick offline test. will include in canary config as toggle-able flag

ade: we need commit sha and quant config in the report (audit). also add a note about classes impacted and fallback route to heron-int8 if recall@1 drops >1% in canary

rachel: already captured: sha=5e3b2f9, quant=per-channel+asym+bias-corr+clamp-tune, postproc=renorm-yes

jon: propose canary 8% traffic, 72h monitoring, alerts: recall@1 drop >0.8% OR silhouette drop >0.03 OR tail(<=-0.08)>1.0%

Tom: +1. also wire quick debug dump for any triggered alert (sample queries + nearest neighbors)

rachel: canary launched at 8% now. will post dashboards and hourly summary

eval-bot: canary-deploy id=canary_2026_03_21_377888 deployed fraction=0.08

ade: thanks all :thumbsup:

jon: if canary looks good, we should run a larger multilingual holdout before prod (to catch cross-lingual drift)

rachel: on the list — scheduling after 12h canary window

Tom: great job — excited to see the int4 win with small quality guardrails

rachel: thanks team, will update if any alerts fire
